# Tasks

Manage tasks in Teamleader Focus.

Tasks — `tasks.*`, the stand-alone task list (with optional links to a
customer, deal, ticket, legacy milestone or project).

Tasks inside a project in the current project system are a different
resource: `ProjectTasks`.

```php
Teamleader::tasks()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Tasks\Tasks` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one |

## Endpoints

- `tasks.complete`
- `tasks.create`
- `tasks.delete`
- `tasks.info`
- `tasks.list`
- `tasks.reopen`
- `tasks.schedule`
- `tasks.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `completed` | Filter by completion status (boolean) |
| `customer` | Filter by customer: [type =&gt; contact\|company, id =&gt; uuid] |
| `due_by` | Tasks due on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `due_from` | Tasks due on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `ids` | Array of task UUIDs |
| `milestone_id` | Filter by milestone UUID (old projects module) |
| `scheduled` | Filter by scheduled status (boolean) |
| `term` | Search term (searches the description) |
| `user_id` | Tasks assigned to this user or to a team they belong to; null for unassigned tasks |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `created_at` | Creation date |
| `due_on` | Due date |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `ASSIGNEE_TYPES` | `team`, `user` |
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `description`, `due_on`, `work_type_id`, `milestone_id`, `project_id`, `deal_id`, `ticket_id`, `estimated_duration`, `assignee`, `customer`, `custom_fields` |
| `CUSTOMER_TYPES` | `contact`, `company` |
| `DURATION_UNITS` | `min` |
| `PRIORITIES` | `A`, `B`, `C`, `D` |
| `REQUIRED_ON_CREATE` | `title`, `due_on`, `work_type_id` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `description`, `due_on`, `work_type_id`, `milestone_id`, `project_id`, `deal_id`, `ticket_id`, `estimated_duration`, `assignee`, `customer`, `custom_fields` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List tasks

- `$filters` — ids, user_id (null = unassigned), milestone_id, completed, scheduled, due_by, due_from, term, customer
- `$options` — page_size, page_number, sort (created_at|due_on), sort_order

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter key, option, value or sort field

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get one task

- `$id` — Task UUID
- `$includes` — tasks.info takes no includes; passing any throws

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a task

Requires title, due_on and work_type_id.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a required field is missing, or a field or value is not accepted

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update a task

Every field is optional. `assignee` null unassigns the task;
milestone_id, project_id, deal_id and ticket_id take null to unlink.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a field or value is not accepted

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a task

### `complete()`

```php
complete(string $id): array
```

Mark a task as complete

- `$id` — Task UUID

### `reopen()`

```php
reopen(string $id): array
```

Reopen a task that had been marked as complete

- `$id` — Task UUID

### `schedule()`

```php
schedule(string $id, string $startsAt, string $endsAt): array
```

Schedule a task in your calendar

- `$id` — Task UUID
- `$startsAt` — ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. 2025-02-04T16:00:00+00:00
- `$endsAt` — ISO 8601 datetime, after $startsAt

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On a malformed datetime, or an end before the start

## Examples

Get all tasks:

```php
$tasks = Teamleader::tasks()->list();
```

Get tasks for a specific user:

```php
$tasks = Teamleader::tasks()->forUser("user-uuid");
```

Get incomplete tasks:

```php
$tasks = Teamleader::tasks()->incomplete();
```

Create a new task:

```php
$task = Teamleader::tasks()->create([
    "title" => "Review code changes",
    "due_on" => "2025-02-15",
    "work_type_id" => "work-type-uuid"
]);
```

Update a task:

```php
$task = Teamleader::tasks()->update("task-uuid", [
    "title" => "Updated task title"
]);
```

Mark a task as complete:

```php
$result = Teamleader::tasks()->complete("task-uuid");
```

Reopen a completed task:

```php
$result = Teamleader::tasks()->reopen("task-uuid");
```

Schedule a task in calendar:

```php
$event = Teamleader::tasks()->schedule(
    "task-uuid",
    "2025-02-15T09:00:00+00:00",
    "2025-02-15T10:00:00+00:00"
);
```
